desc: Implement and validate total grid Manhattan distance over unordered cell pairs: \(n^2 \cdot m(m-1)(m+1)/6 + m^2 \cdot n(n-1)(n+1)/6\).
Implement modular factorials/inverse factorials and compute \(\binom{mn-2}{k-2}\).
Multiply the geometric pair-distance sum by \(\binom{mn-2}{k-2}\), with correct handling of examples and edge cases.
